summary: Close P2 with durable warehouse incident automation, reproducible deployment load/failure qualification, and a narrowly qualified Yandex Market price-write capability without weakening provider-neutral boundaries.

impacts.evidence: Warehouse incidents/decisions use organization/workspace composite keys and FORCE RLS; qualification probes use a dedicated synthetic tenant and normal tenant-scoped Outbox/Inbox paths.
Qualification data is synthetic and evidence excludes credentials/customer PII; the P2 architecture pass also removes policy-breaking variable dispatch left by reconstructed P1 code.
Additive warehouse operational-state/failover/incident operations are declared in OpenAPI and generated SDKs; existing operations remain unchanged.
The deployed-image qualifier exercises canonical commerce.inventory.stock_changed.v1 Outbox -> Kafka -> Inbox delivery and duplicate immutable-event semantics without changing event schema/topic.
Yandex Market adds an existing SDK v1 capability, prices.write, by implementing PriceWriter; no Connector SDK type is changed.
Expand migration 000073 adds incident/decision evidence and extends the durable worker job kind.

Incident worker uses the existing narrow SECURITY DEFINER dispatch only for claiming; business processing returns to tenant-scoped forced-RLS transactions. Qualification fails closed and does not persist secret values.
Incident routing only selects explicit enabled routes with healthy destination and positive ATP; no implicit inventory move is authorized.
Per-offer incident decisions are append-only evidence; no route decision is represented as physical stock transfer.

Incident decision primary key is incident+offer; worker cursor/bounded batches are restart-safe. Runtime qualifier proves one Inbox receipt under duplicate broker delivery and continued marker progress.
Webhook egress contracts do not change; deployed Kafka->Inbox path remains the same production consumer boundary.
Task-066 deterministic profiles are retained and P2 adds black-box API availability/p99/throughput evidence plus Outbox/Inbox timing from the actual image.
Qualification includes worker/Kafka/PostgreSQL restart drills. Migration 73 is expand-only and migration 72 preserves allocation safety during mixed-version rollout.
Yandex write tests, migration safety checks, architecture/migration/contracts/SDK gates and an explicit Docker production-qualification gate cover P2.
